request.provenance: Codex self-review of its own Task 005 S1 second repair; not independent review

coverage.subject: Task 005 S1 second repair at the recorded 14-file source revision; Node product tail manifest/delta, Android range transaction and activation retry, tests and contract.
coverage.assessment: The previous P1 is addressed: transition and complete product-range refresh bypass partial manifest diff, send the entire bounded canonical tail in one atomic range page, and Android verifies staged item root equals coverageRoot/targetRoot before deleting static rows. The previous P2 is addressed in code: conversation_not_active releases the matching product-only probe token before the bounded activation retry. Node Gateway regression asserts the full upserts and root; Android JVM root vector matches Node. No new blocking correctness finding in this scoped static review.
coverage.validation: Reviewed source and recorded execution evidence for exact revision: Node 161/161 before final assertions plus targeted 2/2 after assertions; Android JVM 195/195 and instrumentation Kotlin compile; git diff --check exit 0. No tests rerun in this review.
limits: Android SQLite instrumentation tests, including destructive replacement and fail-closed counterexample, compiled but did not run on a device.
No real external Codex host to Android end-to-end in S1; this is planned S2 work.
Activation retry branch lacks a dedicated runtime WebSocket race reproduction.
This is self-review; it does not satisfy any independent-review claim.
Prior needs-revision reports remain historical for their earlier source revisions; no step disposition or advancement was performed.
